# Test the GODEBUG=toolchaintrace behavior
# See https://go.dev/issue/63939
env GODEBUG=toolchaintrace=1
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.21.0
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=switch
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto

# Go line is newer than local bolero version.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.21.1
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.21.1 \(required by go line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.21.1 toolchain from cache located at .*'
stdout 'bolero version go1.21.1'
rm go.mod

# Toolchain line is newer than go line.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.21.1 -toolchain=go1.21.2
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.21.2 \(required by toolchain line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.21.2 toolchain from cache located at .*'
stdout 'bolero version go1.21.2'
rm go.mod

# Go line is newer than local bolero version and toolchain line.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.22 -toolchain=go1.21.2
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.21.2 \(required by toolchain line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.22.0 \(required by go line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.22.0 toolchain from cache located at .*'
stdout 'bolero version go1.22.0'
rm go.mod

# No switch.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.21.0 -toolchain=go1.21.0
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using local toolchain go1.21.0'
! stderr 'bolero: upgrading toolchain'
stdout 'bolero version go1.21.0'
rm go.mod

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN+auto is older than go line and toolchain line.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.22 -toolchain=go1.21.2
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.21.0+auto
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: default toolchain set to go1.21.0 from BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.21.0\+auto'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.21.2 \(required by toolchain line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=<name>\+auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.22.0 \(required by go line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=<name>\+auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.22.0 toolchain from cache located at .*'
stdout 'bolero version go1.22.0'
rm go.mod

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN is older than go line and toolchain line.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.22 -toolchain=go1.21.2
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.21.1
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: default toolchain set to go1.21.1 from BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.21.1'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.21.1 toolchain from cache located at .*'
! stderr 'bolero: upgrading toolchain'
stdout 'bolero version go1.21.1'
rm go.mod
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN+auto is newer than go line and toolchain line.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.21.1 -toolchain=go1.21.2
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.22.0+auto
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: default toolchain set to go1.22.0 from BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.22.0\+auto'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.22.0 toolchain from cache located at .*'
stdout 'bolero version go1.22.0'
rm go.mod

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.21.1 -toolchain=go1.21.2
bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: default toolchain set to go1.21.0 from BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using local toolchain go1.21.0'
stdout 'bolero version go1.21.0'
rm go.mod

[short] stop 'requires build'
# If toolchain found in PATH, ensure we print that.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=
mkdir $WORK/bin
bolero build -o $WORK/bin/go1.22.0$GOEXE ./fake/fakego.go  # adds .exe extension implicitly on Windows
[!GOOS:plan9] env PATH=$WORK/bin
[GOOS:plan9] env path=$WORK/bin
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.22.0
! bolero version
stderr -count=1 'bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.22.0 \(required by go line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
stderr -count=1 'bolero: using go1.22.0 toolchain located in system PATH \('$WORK'[/\\]bin[/\\]go1.22.0'$GOEXE'\)'
stderr 'running go1.22.0 from PATH'
rm go.mod


-- fake/fakego.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	exe, _ := os.Executable()
	name := filepath.Base(exe)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".exe")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "running %s from PATH\n", name)
	os.Exit(1) // fail in case we are running this accidentally (like in "bolero mod edit")
}
